What kind of story is A Little Princess?

A Little Princess is the story of Sara, a once-wealthy girl who never loses her dignity, kindness, and imagination even when she suddenly falls into hard circumstances. The way she keeps the princess in her heart in any situation resonates deeply.

content.alt: A Little Princess - The original story of A Little Princess
content.text:
The original story of A Little Princess

A work published in 1905 by English author Frances Hodgson Burnett. It's the story of Sara, once a wealthy boarding-school student, who overnight becomes a servant due to her father's misfortune, yet keeps her kindness and dignity to the end and finally reclaims her happiness.

content.alt: A Little Princess - A Little Princess plot summary
content.text:
A Little Princess plot summary

Once wealthy, Sara is forced into a hard life like a servant due to her father's sudden misfortune. Yet she endures the hardship through imagination and helps those in even greater need, never losing her dignity. At last the truth comes to light, and Sara reclaims a warm happiness.
content.caption: A heart that endures through imagination

content.alt: A Little Princess - The lessons of A Little Princess
content.text:
The lessons of A Little Princess

The core message is a heart that never loses kindness and dignity in any circumstance, and the warmth to help those in greater need. Try asking your child, "Can you be kind even when things are hard?"
content.caption: The happiness that dignity brought

content.alt: A Little Princess - How to read it aloud to your child
content.text:
How to read it aloud to your child

Read Sara's dignified way of speaking calmly and warmly. Talk about kindness and dignity with questions like, "How can you keep your heart steady even in hard times?" and "Have you ever helped a friend who was worse off than you?" Suitable for ages 5-7.

content.text:
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q. What age is A Little Princess good for?
A. It's suitable for ages 5-7. With its deep themes of dignity and kindness, it's good for a time when emotions are growing richer.

Q. Won't the content be too sad?
A. There are hard times, but the ending is warm, and positive messages of kindness and dignity are at its center.

Q. What kind of conversation is good to have?
A. Try talking together about "being kind even when it's hard," "helping those in greater need," and "keeping the dignity in your heart."
